tips.injection: Consistent timing keeps medication levels stable. Shifting your dose day within a 24-hour window is clinically fine.
tips.protein: Hitting 80% or more of your protein floor protects lean muscle while GLP-1 does its job. Aim for consistency over perfection.
tips.streak: Every green day fueled your muscle preservation goal. A missed day doesn't undo progress - keep going tomorrow.
tips.symptoms: Symptoms usually settle as your body adjusts. Symptoms persisting beyond two weeks or sharply worsening deserve a prescriber conversation.
tips.weight: Your weight line connects every entry you log. Day-to-day swings are normal - hydration and food timing affect the scale. Look at the direction over weeks, not single days.
